description: Family-level model-selection receipt for finance forecast generator variants.
purpose: This contract consumes multiple split-bound finance_variant_admission_receipt_v0 pairwise gates, builds a shared-event family loss matrix, exposes Reality Check bootstrap conformance and sample-gated SPA evidence, and prevents best-of-many variant cherry-picking from becoming mutation authority.

selection_id.constraint: Stable receipt id for the family-level model-selection pass.

method.constraint: v0 supports reserved family-selection methods plus sample-gated Reality Check bootstrap evidence.

baseline_variant_id.constraint: Must be shared across all consumed pairwise gates before family inference can be trusted.

variant_set.constraint: Baseline plus all candidate variants represented by the consumed receipts.

receipt_refs.constraint: finance_variant_admission_receipt_v0 variant_gate_id values consumed by this family receipt.

loss_metric.constraint: Must be shared across all consumed receipts.

family_loss_matrix.constraint: finance_family_loss_matrix_v0 built from shared comparison_event_key rows across all candidate variants.

bootstrap.constraint: Must name method, authority, reps, seed, sample gate, and whether p-values were computed.

bootstrap_conformance.constraint: Must make the Reality Check statistic orientation, centering, resampling plan, sample gate, null, and evidence-only authority explicit.

bootstrap_reference_status.constraint: Compact hook for deterministic reference-suite status. Values include not_started, pass, and fail.

spa_readiness.constraint: Must expose whether poor/irrelevant alternatives are present and whether SPA studentization/sample-dependent-null prerequisites are available or blocked.

rows.constraint: Each row is one comparison_event_key with losses for baseline and every candidate variant retained in the shared intersection.

coverage.constraint: Must include shared_event_count, dropped_unshared_event_count, candidate_event_counts, and blocked_reason_counts.

dependence_diagnostics.constraint: Must include event_window_overlap_count, recommended_block_length, and bootstrap_method before any family statistic is interpreted.

method.constraint: v0 uses stationary_bootstrap when Reality Check is computed.

conformance_status.constraint: Mirrors bootstrap_conformance.status for compact operating-picture consumers.

fixture_only.constraint: True only for explicit tiny-bootstrap fixture/test runs; never production-admissive.

centering.constraint: v0 centers candidate loss differentials by each candidate mean before bootstrap null resampling.

resampling.constraint: Must include method, seed, bootstrap_reps, and block_length.

sample_gate.constraint: Must include minimum_sample, sample_size, and passed.

poor_or_irrelevant_alternative_count.constraint: Counts candidate variants with non-improving mean candidate-minus-baseline loss deltas; this is a warning that SPA may be more appropriate than Reality Check.

studentized_loss_differentials_available.constraint: True when tools/finance/spa_statistics.py has run or sample-gated the SPA path; false only when blocked before the SPA kernel.

sample_dependent_null_available.constraint: True when the SPA block includes sample-dependent-null metadata; false only when blocked before the SPA kernel.

reason.constraint: Explains whether SPA is blocked or reserved-ready.

status.constraint: Examples: computed_bootstrap, not_computed_minimum_sample, not_computed_no_studentization, or blocked/not_computed_* family blocker statuses.

studentization.constraint: Must include variance estimator, minimum variance floor, studentized candidate count, dropped zero-variance count, and candidate diagnostics.

sample_dependent_null.constraint: Must expose poor/irrelevant alternative handling, included candidate count, and whether the sample-dependent null was computed.

bootstrap.constraint: Must name method, reps, seed, and block_length.

observed_statistic.constraint: Studentized max positive baseline improvement under candidate-minus-baseline lower-is-better orientation.

kind.constraint: The single shared executable split policy kind, or null when mixed.

all_receipts_split_bound.constraint: False blocks Reality Check / SPA / MCS interpretation.

candidate_count.constraint: At least two candidates are required before family-level selection is more than diagnostic.

shared_event_count.constraint: Shared comparison_event_key count in the family loss matrix after split and coverage exclusions.

best_mean_delta_variant_id.constraint: Best-looking candidate by pairwise mean loss delta; this is descriptive and never mutation authority in v0.

retained_shadow_variants.constraint: Shadow candidate variants retained for diagnostic family tracking.

reality_check.constraint: Sample-gated White Reality Check block. A computed p-value is evidence only and never mutation authority in v0.

spa.constraint: Sample-gated Hansen-SPA-style statistic block. A computed p-value is evidence only and never mutation authority in v0.

model_confidence_set.constraint: Reserved or blocked Model Confidence Set block.

reason.constraint: Examples: family_level_selection_not_admissive, insufficient_variant_family, mixed_split_policy, split_membership_unbound, unknown_variant.
